name: AppleJuicer
concept: The juice stall at the Everon market (#924): a trader presses the village apples into juice with a tall white enamel commercial juicer of the kind a 1989 market kiosk used, mains powered, bought from the state catering supplier (concept 7, the maintainer's pick; the hand-crank presses were rejected as not era-current). It stands on the stall counter beside the crates of apples and is the prop the Press Apples action belongs to.
prompt: Tall white enamel commercial fruit juicer of a late-1980s market kiosk: a square motor block, a steel bowl with a pulp drawer above it, a steel feed hopper with a wooden pusher, a steel spout at the front. no text, no logos.
